name: cubbie-dashboard
description: Local Cubbie dashboard for Canvas, iMessage and Tesseract.

scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @cubbie/web test && corepack pnpm test:local && corepack pnpm --filter @cubbie/tesseract test
